title: Edge provisioning fail patterns and sandbox triage 2026-09-14
content:
Purpose: capture observed failure patterns in edge sandbox provisioning over the past two sprints, synthesize quick mitigations, assign owners for runbook updates, and feed back into installer CI templates.

Context / why this matters:
- Over the last 10 sandboxes spun up for customer preview, 4 had non-deterministic provisioning failures. These are blocking quick validation loops for new on-prem installers and increase debugging time when migrating to customer networks.
- We need an actionable short list: immediate mitigations to reduce blast radius, and longer-term fixes to bake into the provisioning pipeline and runbook.

Observed failure clusters (patterns):
1) DHCP / IP exhaustion during parallel node boot (3 occurrences)
   - Symptoms: nodes stalled at cloud-init waiting for DHCP leases; installer timeout at 450s.
   - Root-cause hypothesis: default sandbox subnet (/24) + aggressive parallel k8s node provisioning + flaky DHCP reserve in virtualized sandboxes.
   - Notes from logs: "dhclient: no available leases" followed by systemd-networkd retry loop.

2) iSCSI mount race on storage node (1 occurrence)
   - Symptoms: kubelet failing to attach PVs, mount timeout, pods CrashLoopBackOff.
   - Hypothesis: device path not stable until multipath completes — race between storage init container and multipathd.
   - Temporary workaround applied: increased attach timeout to 180s in sandbox profile.

3) KMS/HSM handshake timeouts for encrypted volumes (mixed, 2 occurrences)
   - Symptoms: volume creation fails with 504 from KMS proxy; installer retries then bails.
   - Hypothesis: test KMS endpoint in sandbox overloaded by parallel encrypt ops.
   - Mitigation applied: serialized KMS calls in sandbox and added exponential backoff.

4) Ephemeral certificate authority mismatch during bootstrap (1 occurrence)
   - Symptoms: controlplane cert rotation failed; cluster bootstrap paused.
   - Root-cause: stale CA cert in sandbox artifacts from previous runs.
   - Mitigation: added preflight check to validate CA freshness and trash stale certs in /tmp/install-ca.*

Incidents timeline (short):
- 2026-09-03: Sandbox A – parallel DHCP failure (PD-2743)
- 2026-09-07: Sandbox B – iSCSI mount race observed; hotfix push to timeout (PR 342)
- 2026-09-09: Sandbox C – KMS proxy 504; rollback to serialized calls applied
- 2026-09-13: Sandbox D – stale CA surfaced during controlplane init

Quick wins (apply within 48–72 hrs):
- Reduce default parallelism for sandbox provisioning from 8 -> 4 nodes by default (Owner: Liam, due: 2026-09-17).
- Add DHCP availability preflight: check subnet free IPs > expected_nodes + 10 (Owner: Ravi, due: 2026-09-16).
- Make installing script idempotent for stale CA artifacts (Owner: Asha, due: 2026-09-18).
- Set temporary install profile flag: "serialize-kms=true" which adds 1s jitter + exponential backoff for sandbox runs (Owner: Sofia, due: 2026-09-16).

Longer-term engineering actions (PI planning):
- Rework sandbox network templates to use /22 by default for parallel testbeds; investigate dynamic subnet allocation (Owner: Platform eng, PR in PI-4).
- Implement multipath-aware attach logic in installer (Owner: storage-systems team, design doc due 2026-09-30).
- Add KMS load/emulation in CI so we don't rely on single sandbox KMS instance (Owner: infra-team, spike by 2026-10-07).
- Expand preflight coverage: run a small synthetic workload post-provision (curl health endpoints, mount/unmount one test PV) before marking a sandbox healthy (Owner: SRE, spec by 2026-09-27).

Runbook updates (immediate items to commit):
- Add a new section "Sandbox: common provisioning anti-patterns" with reproducible logs and CLI diff examples (assigned to Asha).
- Add a short troubleshooting checklist for "dhcp-no-leases" with commands, expected outputs, and quick fixes (assigned to Ravi).
- Document CA artifact freshness check + commands to clear cached CA files (assigned to Asha + Marta).

Decision log (from sync):
- Agreed to prefer conservative defaults in sandboxes over aggressive parallelism to reduce flakiness. (consensus)
- Will not block-on major refactor to multipath attach; instead ship timeouts and add observability immediately. (voted 4–0)

Open questions and unresolved items:
- Should we instrument a per-sandbox KMS queue limiter or rely on serialized calls? (action: Sofia to prototype and report back)
- Customer preview timeline might require us to keep faster parallelism for a few curated testbeds; how to balance speed vs stability? (action: Product to nominate two "high-speed" sandboxes)

Communications and customer-facing notes:
- For customers in preview whose sandboxes hit DHCP issues, we should offer immediate reprovisioning with larger subnets and a brief explanation of temporary defaults. Draft note (copy):
  "We observed intermittent DHCP lease exhaustion in our parallel-install sandboxes. We've implemented conservative defaults and will reprovision your environment with more IP capacity — no data lost. Expect a short window where we'll re-run installs and validate your cluster."

Testing and CI adjustments (practical):
- Add integration job that runs a 4-node sandbox twice in sequence to catch stale-artifact regressions (Owner: DevInfra, ticket: PD-2810).
- Add log-snippet-based flakiness detector that flags repeated "no available leases" patterns in a build (Owner: Observability, ETA 2 sprints).

Action items (consolidated):
- Liam: change sandbox default parallelism -> 4 (due 2026-09-17)
- Ravi: DHCP preflight check script and docs (due 2026-09-16)
- Sofia: prototype KMS queue limiter vs serialized calls (due 2026-09-20)
- Asha: runbook section for sandbox anti-patterns + CA freshness remediation (due 2026-09-18)
- Marta: add CA cleanup commands into installer preflight (due 2026-09-18)
- Platform eng: design doc for /22 sandbox network templates (due 2026-09-30)
- Storage-systems: multipath-aware attach design (due 2026-09-30)
- DevInfra: CI job for repeat sandbox smoke test (PD-2810, due 2026-09-22)

Notes to self / follow-ups:
- Capture one reproducible sandbox with DHCP failure and attach to PD-2743 as a repro-case (Ravi).
- When shipping the "serialize-kms" flag, add metric on KMS call latency per sandbox so we can quantify benefit.
- Follow up with Solutions Eng to see if any customer-specific network topologies (NAT-heavy or /30-ish subnets) need special guidance.

Meeting attendees (quick): Asha (lead), Liam, Sofia, Ravi, Marta, Priya (solutions eng, joined for last 20m).

Appendix: useful commands seen in logs (copied as reference)
- dhclient: sudo dhclient -v eth0  # shows lease acquisition and errors
- check ip availability: ipcalc -n -b 10.0.8.0/24 ; python3 -c 'print(len(list(ipaddress.ip_network("10.0.8.0/24").hosts())))'
- CA freshness: ls -ltr /tmp/install-ca.* ; openssl x509 -in /tmp/install-ca.pem -noout -dates
- quick PV attach debug: journalctl -u multipathd -n 200 ; ls -l /dev/disk/by-path/

End of notes.

(Informal: this doc is a working capture — expect small edits. If you have repros, drop them into PD-2743 and tag @asha.)
